mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: This is a self-hosted, FOSS platform that turns a Kubernetes cluster into a Heroku-like experience, making it easy for developers to deploy and host small projects. It has grown to roughly 2,000 active developers and is built in Rails + Stimulus.
mentions.problem: The author's previous startup needed Kubernetes flexibility but developers hated using Kubernetes, so Canine was created to remove that pain point.
mentions.audience: Developers, with about 2,000 active developers using it to host small projects
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been slowly working on https://github.com/CanineHQ/canine for about 2 years now. Basically a self hosted, FOSS that turns a Kubernetes cluster into something as easy to use as Heroku. Its grown to about 2000 active developers using it host small things at https://canine.sh
